name: @pipeworx/mcp-ftc-enforcement

tools.name: ftc_search_cases
tools.description: Search FTC (Federal Trade Commission) enforcement cases and proceedings by company name, individual name, case/matter number, or keyword, with optional date range, merger-vs-non-merger filter, and case-status filter. Covers both competition (antitrust/merger) and consumer-protection enforcement — complaints, consent orders, settlements, and federal-court actions. Returns each matching case's title, FTC slug (pass to ftc_case_detail for documents), type of action, case status, and last-updated date. Example: ftc_search_cases({ query: "Kroger", category: "merger" }).

query.description: Company name, individual name, case/matter number, or keyword. Omit to browse all cases (combine with category/status/dates).

category.description: Restrict to merger enforcement, non-merger (conduct) enforcement, or both ("any", the default).

status.description: Restrict to cases in this status. Omit for any status.

start_date.description: Earliest "last updated" date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Latest "last updated" date to include, YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Max cases to return, newest-updated first. Default 20, max 100.

tools.name: ftc_case_detail
tools.description: Get full detail for one FTC case or proceeding: case status (pending/closed/under order), federal court (if any), the full party caption, the case summary, any linked press release, and the complete document timeline (complaint, orders, settlements, briefs) each with its filing date, document title, and PDF URL. Takes the `slug` field returned by ftc_search_cases or ftc_recent_actions — the last path segment of the case's ftc.gov URL, e.g. "hims-hers" for https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/cases-proceedings/hims-hers. Example: ftc_case_detail({ slug: "hims-hers" }).

slug.description: The case's ftc.gov slug (last URL path segment), or the full cases-proceedings URL — either is accepted.

tools.name: ftc_recent_actions
tools.description: Get the most recent FTC enforcement actions (cases and proceedings), newest first — new complaints, settlements, and orders across both competition and consumer-protection enforcement. Optionally restrict to merger enforcement only or non-merger (conduct) enforcement only. Answers "what has the FTC done recently" / "what merger actions has the FTC taken this month." Example: ftc_recent_actions({ days: 30, category: "merger", limit: 10 }).

days.description: How many days back from today to look, by last-updated date. Default 30.

category.description: Restrict to merger enforcement, non-merger (conduct) enforcement, or both ("any", the default).

limit.description: Max actions to return, newest first. Default 20, max 100.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ftc-enforcement forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ftc-enforcement pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
